display.title: Rosh Chodesh Shevat: Praying for Peace and the Third Beis HaMikdash
display.summary_short: As the month of Shevat begins, Uncle Yossi explains why the third Beis HaMikdash, built by Hashem Himself, will stand forever.
display.summary_long: A short talk from the Tzivos Hashem radio show, given as the month of Shevat began. Uncle Yossi recalls that on Shabbos Mevarchim we prayed that the new month bring joy, happiness and above all lasting peace. The greatest peace, for all mankind, will come with Moshiach, who will gather the Jewish people from the four corners of the world and bring them back to the Holy Land. Our Sages teach that the third Beis HaMikdash will be different from the first two: those were built by people and destroyed by enemies, but the third will be built by Hashem Himself, as the verse says 'Mikdash Hashem konenu yadecha', and so it will stand forever. Uncle Yossi ends with the hope that it happens very soon, because everybody wants Moshiach now.
display.lesson: Pray each new month for peace and for the Geulah; the third Beis HaMikdash, built by Hashem, will last forever.
